questions.info: The option will recommend or even forbid some tools. For examplee, very deep cuts cannot be performed by a waterjet tool

options.info: Deep cuts require real contact with the dough. It is not possible with contactless tool such as waterjet.
Highly hydrated dough requires contactless tool or tool with cleaning options such as dip tanks
Large seeds inclusions require a blade to cut through the seeds. It does not fit well with a waterjet tool.
Highly floured products require cleaning options to remove build up on the blade. They also cause a lot of splashes when used with waterjet.
Light products are very sensitive to motion while being scored. Contactless tool are prefered for this.
The option will recommend or even forbid some tools. For examplee, very deep cuts cannot be performed by a waterjet tool

questions.info: Tool option is needed to know which options come with it. For example, the waterjet comes with a pump system when ultrasonic drag can come with dip tank
